findings.message: The default Legend is no longer centered: the root changed from a full-width flex with `justifyContent="center"` to an `inline-flex` aligned to `flex-start`, so any caller that doesn't pass `alignSelf="center"` now gets a left-aligned legend. A consumer renders `<Legend series={series} />` under a custom chart, or inside any block or non-column-flex parent. Before this change the items were centered. Now the legend shrinks to fit its content and sits at the start edge. Only BarChart and LineChart were updated with `alignSelf="center"`, and that prop has no effect in a block parent anyway. This is a silent visual regression for a public component.

`aria-label={label ?? 'Chart legend'}` only falls back when `label` is null or undefined, while the visible label is shown only when `label` is truthy, so `label=""` gives a list with an empty accessible name. A caller passes `label={title}` where `title` is `''` (for example, an untitled chart). Nothing visible is rendered, and the list gets `aria-label=""` instead of 'Chart legend', so screen readers announce an unnamed list. Use `label || 'Chart legend'` instead.
